 Health Canada issued new product recall notices for baby nests and loungers sold at Walmart, Winners, HomeSense, Marshalls and on Amazon. 
 Other recent recalls include those for space heaters sold on Amazon that could ignite and gas boilers sold in Canada and the U.S. following incidents, including one reported incident where “the technician servicing the boiler sustained a broken jaw.”
 Simmons Kozy and Nido baby nests and loungers 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Issue Fall risk. Health Canada determined the baby nests and loungers don’t meet Canadian regulations for cribs, cradles and bassinets
 Where sold 25,088 units of the affected products were sold in Canada from January 2022 to September 2026, including through Walmart, Winners, HomeSense, Marshalls and Amazon 
 What to do Immediately stop using the recalled baby loungers and nests and dispose of them in a way that they can’t be used again.
 Place of origin China
 Simmons Kozy and Nido baby nests and loungers sold in Canada recalled.
 Health Canada

 Evelyn Harford 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW
 Home Hardware snow thrower recall: Benchmark 22-inch, 15-amp electric snow thrower 
 Issue Electric shock
 Where sold The company reported 37,667 units were sold in Canada, including at Home Hardware, between November 2020 and May 2026.
 What to do Immediately stop using the recalled snow thrower and contact Home Hardware for instructions on how to destroy the product in exchange for a refund.
 electric snow thrower 
 Product description 
 Product description The product has a red and black base and wheels and a black handle. The word “BENCHMARK” is written on the side of the product.
 Model no. YF6022
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 News 
 Home Hardware snow thrower recall: What Canadian customers need to know 
 Evelyn Harford 
 Certain NTI and HTP brand residential gas boilers 
 Issue Fire, poisoning, impact risk
 Where sold 2,261 units of the recalled gas boilers were sold in Canada and 4,726 were sold in the United States from May 2021 to August 2025.
 What to do Immediately stop using the recalled gas boilers and contact Ariston Canada Inc.  to get a free upgrade kit and assistance in arranging to have a certified technician install the upgrade kit to your boiler.
 NTI brand residential gas boilers in the FTVN and TFTN model series and HTP brand residential gas boilers in the FTVN, TFTN and EFTU model series have been recalled.
 Health Canada 
 Product details 
 The recall impacts NTI brand residential gas boilers in the FTVN and TFTN model series, and HTP brand residential gas boilers in the EFTU model series.
 You can find the serial number on the rating plate, which is on the side panel of the boiler cabinet.

 DREO heater recall 
 Issue Fire and burn risks
 Where sold 36,288 units of the affected products were sold in Canada, including on Amazon, and 338,800 were sold in the United States from September 2025 to August 2026.
 What to do Immediately stop using and contact DREO to receive a free replacement space heater.
 DREO space heater recalled due to fire and burn hazards.
 Health Canada 
 Product detail  
 Product DREO portable oscillating ceramic space heaters that include a remote control
 Model no. DR-HSH015
 Manufacturing dates Affected units were manufactured from April 2025 (2025/04) to January 2026 (2026/01).
 Colour Black
 Measurements 29 cm wide by 33 cm tall
 Place of origin Vietnam

 Instant Aid Ovulation and Pregnancy Tests 
 Issue  Unauthorized, unlicensed devices for both pregnancy and ovulation tests.
 Where sold In Canada
 What to do  Contact the manufacturer for additional information.
 Product details 
 Brand  Instant Aid 
 Product  Ovulation tester and pregnancy test 
 Company  Tj Trading Co. Inc. Dba Three Star Industries, 260 Bartley Dr., North York, Ont., M4A 2G5
 Health Canada did not share a photo of the recalled product. 
 News 
 Health Canada issues product recall notice for ovulation and pregnancy tests

 Other new product recalls
 ​​Harkla Children’s Compression Sensory Swings​ recalled due to fall hazard 
 ​​Plastic balloons balloon blowing kit​s recalled over chemical risks 
 How to report an issue with a consumer product, drug, cannabis or food
 You can report a food concern or complaint to the Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) online.
 Consumers can report any health or safety incidents related to the use of products by filling out a consumer product incident report form .
 To report a health or safety complaint with a cannabis product, fill out the cannabis reporting form online.
 Report any drug or health product side effects or complaints to Health Canada.
